hint: Fewer bars than requested: the data feed holds only this much history for this symbol and interval (intraday history is limited to a few thousand bars; daily and weekly bars go back to the listing). Use a larger interval (1D, 1W) for a longer time span.
notice: Market data notice: bars are served under the user's TradingView plan and exchange subscriptions (realtime where the user has the exchange data, otherwise delayed); the last bar is still forming and may change; regular session only; prices are split-adjusted only. For the most recent quote use get_symbol_data (or get_symbol_data_batch) with the "close", "change" and "update_mode" columns.

summary.volume_unit_note: avg_volume / total_volume / last_bar_volume are in BASE units (shares for equities, base tokens for crypto). Do NOT prepend $ to these. last_bar_notional_estimate is approximately the dollar volume of the LAST bar (close × volume), valid only for USD-equivalent quote currencies (USDT/USDC/USD/USX equities).
